title: Motion (Jurado – Soto-Martinez) relative to providing clear guidance on the Los Angeles Police Department's legal authority, limitations, and…
text:
[Council File 26-1349]
Motion (Jurado – Soto-Martinez) relative to providing clear guidance on the Los Angeles Police Department's legal authority, limitations, and responsibilities when responding to eviction related calls and alleged unlawful lockouts.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council motion asking for clear guidance on the Los Angeles Police Department's legal authority, limits and responsibilities when responding to eviction-related calls and alleged unlawful lockouts. The Housing Committee adopted it.
